---

Use this for work that is already agreed on in principle: something the original
game did that Galaxies does not do yet, or a defined chunk of work someone just
needs to pick up. If you are proposing a new idea, use the feature request
instead.

**What is missing or needs doing**

Name the specific behavior, screen, or rule. One task per issue.

**How it worked in the original**

Describe the behavior as you remember or observed it: the numbers, the order of
operations, the edge cases. Screenshots from Stars! or from Stars! Nova are the
most useful thing you can attach here.

Please keep this to observed behavior only. Do not paste decompiled or
disassembled code from the original Stars!, which was proprietary and never open
source. Stars! Nova is an independent clean-room reimplementation under GPL v2,
and this project stays on the right side of that line by describing what the
game does, never by copying how it did it.

**Where it lives in Galaxies**

Your best guess at the surface or the code that owns this: desktop client, API,
turn generation, AI, or the marketing site. A guess is fine, and being wrong
costs nothing.

**Definition of done**

What has to be true for this to close. Include the test or the manual check that
would prove it.

**Dependencies**

Anything that has to land first, or any issue this one blocks. Link them.
